description: An ACCDB host made by the probe holds LK linked to T of r-def-cat-txn-lksrc-accdb and a local table L with two rows. DBEngine.CompactDatabase of the host to a new file: errors; in the output, LK's Connect, SourceTableName, Attributes and Updatable, the rows of LK through the link, and the rows of L. The closed outputs are kept.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
